note: Replay goldens of std-lolo-typescript (std-lolo-source with the TypeScript vocabulary). Each case feeds the program and the checker types as the program/read inspect answer (LOLO_INSPECTED; program/read has no substrate host in goldens, G-STD-262), with the installed operator names seeded in the entity. The same cases as lolo-python.replay.goldens.json, each with its paired control. The expected text was also type-checked under strict TypeScript against the models of orb compile -s typescript and run against the kernel answers.
